identity: Your eyes are compound, like those of an insect.  This increases your reaction time, but your fine detailed vision isn't as acute.

identity: Tell me about the songs again.
entries.singular: Tell me about the songs again.

identity: Your body emits enough energy to power some small city.
entries.singular: Your body emits enough energy to power some small city.

identity: They were close to our base, yet they did not attack it.  They were either on another mission or awaiting reinforcements before their attack.  I hope it's the former, for this base is why we did not had to risk our lives in the cities for food.  If they force us to choose between facing a raid or becoming nomads, we might never recover from it.  For now, we're alive and well thanks in no small part to you.

identity: An inactive surgical bonebot.  Using this item involves placing it on the ground and activating it.  If reprogrammed successfully, the nurse bot will then identify you as a friendly, roam around or follow you, and assist you in surgeries.  That is, if you can figure out how to reprogram this thing in the first place.
